### QXO Expands Commitment to Veterans with 2026 QXO for Veterans Program


November 11, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s204.q4cdn.com/433193842/files/doc_news/2026/Nov/11/PDF-Final-QXO-for-Veterans-2026.docx)


*13 Veterans, Gold Star Families and facilities that support veterans will receive a new roof or siding at no cost*


GREENWICH, Conn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


In honor of Veterans Day,[QXO, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.qxo.com%2F&esheet=54638615&newsitemid=20261111156812&lan=en-US&anchor=QXO%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=00d16c2fa60754248e3e4036efbee563) (NYSE: QXO) announced today the launch of its annual QXO for Veterans initiative, honoring veterans, Gold Star Families and the communities that stand behind them. Now in its eighth year, the 2026 QXO for Veterans program is expanding beyond roofing to include siding.


The 2026 program will provide 13 veterans, Gold Star Families and facilities that support veterans with property improvements at no cost. Each winner will receive a new roof or siding installed by local professionals using products from TRI-BUILT®, QXO’s private label brand, and materials from[CertainTeed](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.certainteed.com%2F&esheet=54638615&newsitemid=20261111156812&lan=en-US&anchor=CertainTeed&index=2&md5=80948e9e568fd27e850b500cddef782c) , the 2026 exclusive program partner.


“QXO’s commitment to serving veterans is one of the reasons I chose to join the company,” said Sherri Leach, a U.S. Army veteran and vice president and deputy chief information security officer at QXO. “QXO for Veterans puts that commitment into action by helping protect the homes of veterans returning home. This year, I’m proud that we’re expanding beyond roofing to include siding, helping address another critical need for veterans and their families.”


The nomination period opens today, Veterans Day, and runs through December 31, 2026. The program is open to all military veterans in the U.S. and Canada, and Gold Star Family members. Nominations can be submitted online at[go.qxo.com/qxoforveterans](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fgo.qxo.com%2Fqxoforveterans&esheet=54638615&newsitemid=20261111156812&lan=en-US&anchor=go.qxo.com%2Fqxoforveterans&index=3&md5=7963afa4bc0e63299b0961c6413884d6) or by emailingQXOforVeterans@QXO.com .


A panel of judges, including QXO executives and veterans, the publishers of Roofers Coffee Shop and Roofing Contractor, and executives from[CertainTeed](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.certainteed.com%2F&esheet=54638615&newsitemid=20261111156812&lan=en-US&anchor=CertainTeed&index=4&md5=97c05ffb531d8c44f48cf9320f3f5154) and other organizations, will review all submissions and select the winners.


Since launching in 2018, QXO for Veterans has partnered with local roofing contractors and suppliers across North America to install 70 new roofs for veterans, Gold Star Families and facilities that serve veterans. The initiative is a key part of QXO’s broader commitment to support neighbors, strengthen communities and give back to those who have given so much.


To learn more about QXO for Veterans, including nomination details, past recipients and official program rules, visit[go.qxo.com/qxoforveterans](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fgo.qxo.com%2Fqxoforveterans&esheet=54638615&newsitemid=20261111156812&lan=en-US&anchor=go.qxo.com%2Fqxoforveterans&index=5&md5=ac802c733c15944196a8c02a74abddad) .


**About QXO** QXO is a leading distributor and installer of building products serving an $800 billion market. The Company’s mission is to modernize the building products industry through advanced technology and a best-in-class customer experience. QXO is North America’s largest distributor and installer of insulation, the second-largest distributor of roofing products, the second-largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials, and the largest distributor of waterproofing products. The Company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth. For more information, visit[QXO.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.qxo.com%2F&esheet=54638615&newsitemid=20261111156812&lan=en-US&anchor=QXO.com&index=6&md5=e61eb4ea3fe86923b9fcd699f0a08d6a) .
